bio.intro: Usually has a prototype before the conversation is over.
bio.detail: questions assumptions and has a soft spot for software that quietly does its job for years. Strange Lasers is his love letter to the open source software that gave him the freedom to learn, build, and find his own path.

bio.intro: Usually somewhere down a rabbit hole.
bio.detail: likes building things that probably shouldn't work, then learning why they don't. Curiosity turns into a prototype, the prototype turns into a problem, and the problem usually turns into something new to learn.

bio.intro: Stays calm, stays curious, ships with purpose.
bio.detail: is an optimist who builds digital experiences with one belief: technology should feel human. Engineer, solopreneur, and author who makes things meant to be easier and kinder to use. Calm on the surface, curious underneath. Strange Lasers is where that curiosity gets to roam freely: good team, no steady roadmap, just the joy of building things that matter.
